articles.title: Octopuses Can Use Mirrors to Find Hidden Snacks!
articles.summary: Imagine looking in a mirror to find a treat behind you. Scientists taught octopuses to do just that! They used a mirror to spot a virtual crab, then turned around to get a real one. This shows octopuses are even smarter than we thought.

articles.title: A Tiny Telescope Could Map the Moon's Secret Ingredients!
articles.summary: What is the Moon made of? A new, super-small X-ray telescope might finally give us a full map. It weighs less than a big dog and could scan the whole Moon in just two years. This could unlock secrets about how our lunar neighbor formed.

articles.title: Fire Tornadoes Could Gobble Up Oil Spills Faster and Cleaner!
articles.summary: When oil spills in the ocean, cleaning it up is messy. But scientists just tested giant spinning fire tornadoes that burn oil twice as fast and with way less smoke. This wild idea could save coastlines and sea animals from sticky disasters.
